body.message:
Thank you for your response.

I understand your position; however, I do not recall signing or being provided with a check-in form that clearly stated an early departure would be non-refundable.

To clarify this matter, could you please provide me with a copy of the check-in form or agreement that you state was reviewed and signed by me, including the section that outlines the non-refundable early departure policy? I would also appreciate a copy of the signed document for my records.

Once I have had the opportunity to review the agreement and confirm that these terms were clearly disclosed and accepted, I will be able to better understand your position.

As previously advised, our final check-out date will be Sunday, 2 August. We also appreciate your confirmation that our security deposit will be returned within 7 working days after the inspection, provided no new damages are identified beyond those that were already present when we checked in.

I look forward to receiving a copy of the signed agreement.

Kind regards,
